Previous iter7 RCA: k8s ingress routes ANY path starting with /api* to the FastAPI backend, so the SPA route '/api' was unreachable (backend returned JSON). Fix: renamed frontend route from '/api' to '/developpeurs' in App.js line 71 → route now served by React SPA, ApiKeys component renders normally.
